protection_domains.cybersecurity: secure boot/update design, least privilege, secret protection, tamper detection, threat modeling, audit logs
protection_domains.water_environment: rain, spray, dust, condensation, corrosion and thermal exposure; no ingress rating established
protection_domains.fire_heat_power: battery management, cell monitoring, overcurrent/overvoltage, isolation, thermal propagation and charging fault analysis
protection_domains.communications: GNSS spoofing/denial, network loss, stale commands, V2X authenticity and sensor bus failure
protection_domains.ai_data: camera/radar/lidar provenance, calibration drift, occlusion, weather degradation, uncertainty and adversarial inputs
protection_domains.mechanical: braking, steering, tires, suspension, collision, restraint, stability and independent emergency systems
protection_domains.human_mission: driver override, pedestrian/cyclist protection, emergency response, privacy and minimal-risk condition
